interpolation.madsenBetweenNodeMeaning: Application interpolation between 13 published annual p50 values; not a reconstruction of the authors' fitted GAMLSS model.

limits: This policy selects an educational population central value, not a diagnostic reference interval.
Madsen represents chronological-age models pooling pubertal stages; a Tanner stage is neither inferred nor required.
The published Madsen table includes an exact age-18 node, retained for interpolation below 18. Routing at age 18 uses Kelsey; the source node does not extend Madsen to completed age 18-19.
Reference values genuinely differ at source boundaries. A smooth illustrative display transition cannot supply a patient median or modify source values.
The existing term-infant Busch profile, graphical readability gate and gap from 1 to less than 3 years remain unchanged.
The adult and childhood Kelsey records retain all source points from 3 through 88 years so splitting applicability does not change source PCHIP tangents.
